name: locallyirish
description: Find local businesses anywhere on the island of Ireland and request quotes, via the LocallyIrish MCP server.

interface.longDescription:
LocallyIrish is a directory of over 175,000 local businesses across the island of Ireland, from plumbers and electricians to cafés, salons and solicitors.

With this plugin, ChatGPT can look businesses up directly instead of guessing:
- Search by trade or category and county, optionally only businesses open right now.
- Get a business's address, phone, website, rating and whether it is open now.
- Request quotes: the person's job details go into LocallyIrish's moderated quote queue, and a member of the team reviews each request before it is forwarded to matching local businesses. Nothing is sent automatically.

Every result includes a link to the business's listing on locallyirish.ie. The plugin needs no account and receives only the search terms and, when a person asks for quotes, the contact details they choose to share. It never receives the conversation.
defaultPrompt: Find a well-rated plumber in Sligo
Which cafés in Galway city are open now?
Get me quotes for a new roof in Co. Cork
